title: Q-ROOT-runway-shortfall: runway-shortfall keeps recurring: Measure the component from live data and file the loop that closes it; an unmeasured component counts as below target.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe runway-shortfall
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `runway-shortfall` recurred on 2 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a component of the unattended year is unmeasured or below target and no loop owns closing the gap
Guard: `grep:foundation/runway.py::def`
Remedy: Measure the component from live data and file the loop that closes it; an unmeasured component counts as below target.
Symptoms seen:
- yearfail:10-tenant-loops: tenant-loops the Practical Solutions loops (scan, pipeline, advocates, deploys) run a year; its scheduled workflows fire
- yearfail:11-github-apps: github-apps None
- yearfail:13-final-runway: final-runway after twelve months the runway still meets the target simulated runway None days (target 365, below []); li
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe runway-shortfall

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T19:41:34Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-23T12:31:17Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: guard passes; last occurrence 2026-11-21
